resources.string: Blocks your touches on the screen while the lock is on, so they cannot interfere with what an automation is doing. Input sent over adb, and Phone Relay\'s gestures, still work. Turn the lock on with the ScreenLock widget; hold two fingers still on the screen for 3 seconds, then lift them, to turn it off.
One tap to block your touches on the screen; hold two fingers for 3 seconds to unblock
ScreenLock can\'t lock while explore by touch (TalkBack or similar) is on.
Touches are locked. Hold two fingers still for 3 seconds, then lift them, to unlock.
Ready: lock the screen with the Touch lock widget
The ScreenLock accessibility service is off. Turn it on to use the lock.

Add the Touch lock widget to the home screen (long-press an empty spot, Widgets, ScreenLock) and tap it. It turns on, and from then on touches on the screen reach nothing. The volume and power buttons still work as normal.

Hold two fingers still on the screen for 3 seconds: the phone buzzes twice. Lift them and the lock turns off (one longer buzz). A third finger, or sliding or lifting a finger early, starts it over. Restarting the phone also turns the lock off.

Taps, swipes, keys and text sent over adb, and Phone Relay (it pauses the lock for a moment around each of its gestures). Other accessibility services\' gestures are blocked. From adb:\nadb shell am broadcast -a com.thomaswcode.screenlock.UNLOCK -n com.thomaswcode.screenlock/.CommandReceiver\n(LOCK and STATUS work the same way).
